payload.reason: The evidence indicates that the proposed model utilizes representations from the RXR dataset for language and visual encoding, while training the navigation agent specifically on the R2R and CVDN datasets.

claims.text: The proposed model is trained on the navigation step of R2R and CVDN, while the representation step is taken from RXR.
The model uses multilingual BERT and ResNet pretrained on RXR for encoding instructions and extracting image features.
